Ms. Shreya Chauhan, learned Counsel for respondents No. 2 to 4 has filed reply to the petition,
which is ordered to be taken on record.
2. By way of this writ petition, the petitioner has primarily prayed for the following reliefs:-
Whether reporters of the local papers may be allowed to see the judgment?

.
ii) Quash the decision taken by the respondent/ acquiring authority to unilaterally,
illegally and arbitrarily reduce the compensation determined by Competent Authority-cum- Land Acquisition Officer, Solan from Rs.
4,85,74,236/- to Rs.3,16,57,348/- as well as communication of dated 19.02.2020 (Annexure P-2)
issued by respondent No. 3;
rt iii) Issue appropriate writ, order or direction to the respondent-acquiring authority to deposit the entire compensation, statutory interest, other benefits, etc. with respect to the structure of the petitioner over land comprised in Khata/Khatauni No. 183/270, Khasra No. 1302/1, situated at revenue village Saproon, Tehsil and District Solan (H.P.) as determined vide Award No. 29/B dated 29.09.2018 in the registry of this Hon'ble Court or with the Competent Authority-cum-Land Acquisition Officer, Solan in a time bound manner and to the Competent Authority-cum-Land Acquisition Officer, Solan to disburse the same to the petitioner forthwith thereafter;"
3.

The Court stands informed that in similar cases, the Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court, in CWP No. 3872 of 2019, titled as Vijay Kumar and another vs. Union of India and others, decided on 17.03.2023, alongwith other connected .
matters, has been pleased to dispose of said petitions in the following terms:-
"3.

sentences.text:
During the course of arguments, it has transpired that both the parties have approached the Arbitrator under of Section 3G(5) of The National Highways Act,
1956.
Since the parties have already approached the appropriate authority under the Act, no ground for further interference by this Court rt is called for.

4. However, both the parties would be at liberty to take all the pleas available to them before the Sh. Kartik Dutt vs Union Of India And Others on 10 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5595376/
2 Arbitrator, who is to assess the amount of compensation, in accordance with law,
liable to be paid to the petitioners- claimants/counter-claimants, after hearing both the parties.

entities.text: Kartik Dutt vs Union Of India And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Petitioners-claimants/counterclaimants would also be at liberty to move an application for release of the amount awarded to them before the Arbitrator, who shall decide the same in accordance with law, expeditiously."

4. The Court has also been apprised that in the interregnum, the Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court passed the following interim order in the said writ petitions:-
"It is rather unfortunate that an official of the National Highways Authority of India has sate over the award passed by the competent authority.

Even if it is assumed to exonerate the remedy under the law, the primary condition was to have .
deposited an award amount before this Court after moving an appropriate application to this effect.

Accordingly, respondents No. 2 and 4, are directed to deposit the award amount alongwith up-to-date interest in the Registry of this Court,
within a period of two weeks from today."
of 5.
These facts have not been disputed by the respondents.

Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that rt interest of justice would be served in case this petition is disposed of by directing the authorities to deposit the differential amount with learned Arbitrator, who is presently seized of the matter, as the matter has been assailed both by the petitioner as well as the National Highway Authority of India, with further direction that in the event of any application filed by the petitioner for release of the amount, the same be decided in a time bound manner.

6. Accordingly, this writ petition is disposed of with the direction that let the differential amount be deposited with the learned Arbitrator within a period of six weeks from today by the authority concerned.

In the event of any application filed by the petitioner for release of the differential amount, the same shall be decided by learned Arbitrator, after complying .
with the principles of the natural justice, as expeditiously as possible and not later than three months from today from the date of filing of the application.
The petition stands disposed of in above terms.
